rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AgentGuard MCP server provides a network-egress firewall library for AI agents that evaluates URLs against configurable security policies before making external requests. It offers three tools — check_url, check_urls_batch, and validate_policy — to enforce outbound access controls.
